summary: Tested backend and frontend for AutoParts new features: chat, tracking, pickup discount, admin CRUD, SearchHero homepage. 16/17 backend tests pass (1 skipped). Frontend home, /suivi, admin pages all load. /checkout rendering needs re-verification.

minor.issue: Returns 404 via ingress (root api path not routed). Non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested <a> tags - 'view-btn' Link is nested inside parent image Link. Causes React hydration warning in console on every page.

integration_issues.issue: Navigating directly to /checkout while logged-in admin had 1 item in cart rendered the cart page ('Votre panier') instead of the 3-step CheckoutPage wizard in screenshots. Could be a race where CheckoutPage redirects to /cart before cart is loaded, or MinimalLayout misconfigured. Backend logic (pickup 15%, tracking generation, all 5 payment methods) is fully working via API tests. Main agent should re-verify that clicking 'Passer commande' from cart transitions into the 3-step wizard (shipping method -> address with country selector -> payment methods with 'save card').

action_items: Re-verify /checkout 3-step wizard renders correctly from cart 'Passer commande' click (possible timing/redirect issue observed in test screenshots).

Fix nested <a> tag in ProductCard: the 'view-btn' inside the image Link creates invalid HTML (hydration error). Refactor 'view-btn' to be a sibling or overlay that doesn't nest inside the main product Link.
Optional: expose GET /api/ or update health endpoint (non-critical).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1435 lines - should be split into modules (auth, products, orders, chat, payments) for maintainability.

Order creation: `subtotal` field computed as `total - shipping_cost + discount` - this equals the pre-discount subtotal. It's correct but confusing; consider storing raw subtotal, discount, shipping, total separately upfront.
Chat endpoints /api/chat/{id} and /api/chat/{id}/message are fully public (no auth) - anyone with chat_id can read/post messages. Acceptable for anonymous support widget but document the tradeoff.
ProductCard has nested anchor tags breaking valid HTML. Use button + onClick for inner view-btn OR place it outside the outer Link.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec - browsers may reject credentialed requests. Set explicit origins.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (home/suivi/admin OK, checkout wizard not visually confirmed)

seed_data_creation: 2 chat conversations + 1 pickup order + 1 delivery order created during tests. Cleanup not automated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers: chat CRUD + admin list, tracking public endpoint (security: no user_id leak), pickup order discount (15%), order status admin update, product admin CRUD. All passing. Frontend tested: SearchHero (3 tabs, WhatsApp, stats) OK; /suivi OK with form; ChatWidget button present bottom-right; admin /chat, /products, /orders pages load. NOT fully re-verified: CheckoutPage 3-step wizard UI (test screenshots showed cart instead - likely redirect race). Recommend: click 'Passer commande' from /cart to enter wizard and verify Retrait radio, -15% display, country <select>, 5 payment methods, 'Sauvegarder ma carte' checkbox for stripe.
